title: Linear Spaces of Meanings: Compositional Structures in Vision-Language Models
role: The condition under which CLIP text embeddings are sums of per-factor vectors, which decides what a sentence difference can carry
reads: HuggingFace CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings of clean images and text; the pre-projection token sequence for Stable Diffusion 2.1 pictures
trained_on: nothing trained; pre-trained CLIP, with a randomly initialized encoder as a control
score_enters: No gradient enters a sampler; averaged text embeddings replace the prompt embedding that conditions Stable Diffusion
adding_scores: Text embeddings are sums of factor vectors if and only if embedding differences ignore shared factors, equivalently the factors are conditionally independent given any image (Lemma 2, Corollary 8)
properties: Prompt match partly (zero-shot labels and retrieval on clean images); counting, two-subject binding, spatial relation, position and size not tested
unseen: no: zero-shot labels are used and the seen and unseen pair split is dropped
headline: On MIT-States, ideal words reach 11.5% pair accuracy against 10.0% for real-word labels and 7.7% for all 28175 pair labels; on CelebA the worst-group gap is 1.6 points against 10.1, with CLIP ViT-L/14
copy_or_avoid: Before training, measure the text difference averaged over both word orders, because the additive part of a sentence swap cannot carry binding or left-right order across both orders (inferred)
model: CLIP ViT-L/14; Stable Diffusion 2.1 for pictures
